_comment: Live-data provider policy. Values pinned from the operator-approved discovery gates of 2026-07-12 (docs/decisions.md 'Phase 4 discovery gates'): TaoSwap report 20260712T013740Z-f50d283e, TaoStats report 20260712T014512Z-0ee4f8c4. TaoStats free tier: 5/min, 10,000/MONTH; Atlas self-caps at 2/min (headroom by design) and reserves 20% of the month for interactive use. Price checking spends no TaoStats quota (Q30).

quota._rate_note: no documented/observed limit — politeness policy per ATLAS-LIVE-007

taostats._timeout_note: observed spiky latency (>20s) from the Pi during discovery and acceptance

gate_signal._comment: Emission-gate crossing signal (change: gate-crossing-signal). DEFAULTS OFF: `enabled` false makes poll-gate inert and the Telegram gate-crossing class silent — flipping it is the whole rollback. Reads the spec-440 gate state (theta/q/h) from finney via keyless JSON-RPC state_getStorage on PINNED pre-verified keys (twox128('SubtensorModule') ++ twox128(item); verified against live Finney 2026-07-28), all at one finalized block. Null storage is normal (Substrate never writes ValueQuery defaults): null q/h uses assumed_defaults marked assumed-default provenance (spec-440 code defaults — live q was ALREADY explicit 0.75 on 2026-07-28); null/zero theta records gate-inactive. Demand shares come from the subnets_taoswap panel of the same pass, normalized over ALL non-root subnets (the chain's bar universe includes emission-disabled subnets). hysteresis_pct is the relative band around theta a share must exit on confirm_polls consecutive polls to flip a side; absence_clear_polls clears a vanished netuid's side (netuid-reuse guard). rpc_endpoints are tried in order; verify reachability from the Pi at deploy and record the choice in docs/decisions.md.
gate_signal._rank_comment: EmissionBarRank (change: network-drift-443) arrived with spec 441 (PR #3014) and CHANGED THE BAR'S SELECTION RULE: when N > 0 theta is pinned to the Nth-largest POSITIVE demand share and EmissionBarQuantile is inert; q-mass selection only applies at N == 0. Codec is SCALE u16 (2 bytes LE), NOT the U64F64 the other three items use. The code default at tag v443 is 32 (pallets/subtensor/src/lib.rs, DefaultEmissionBarRank) — chosen because q=0.75 was crossing at about rank 28, so the upgrade was tuned not to shift the emission curve. NOTE: the v441 RELEASE NOTES say the default is 64 and are WRONG; the code is authoritative. Chain-verified 2026-08-06: the key is unset on Finney, so the default applies and rank mode is ACTIVE.
gate_signal._tolerance_comment: above_count_tolerance is 1, not 0 (change: network-drift-452). The chain recalculates theta every 360 blocks and holds it fixed between recalculations while the panel EMA keeps moving, so between recalculations the Nth subnet sits ON the bar and counts on either side of it. Measured 2026-08-24..31: theta changed on 39 of 47 consecutive hourly polls and the count read 31 on 32 polls and 32 on 16, never further. A divergence of two or more is the smallest that cannot be the boundary subnet and still records invariant-divergence.

chain_params._comment: Root-settable chain-parameter watch (change: network-drift-443). DEFAULTS OFF: `enabled` false makes the watch inert and the Telegram chain-parameter-change class silent — flipping it is the whole rollback. Watches discrete knobs whose flip changes network economics without leaving an AdminUtils extrinsic trail (the same reason the gate poll reads q/h rather than assuming code defaults). `source: gate-poll` items are NOT re-read: the gate poll already decodes them at its finalized block and hands them over, so each item is read once and has one history. `source: independent` items carry their own pinned key (twox128('SubtensorModule') ++ twox128(item), verified against live Finney 2026-08-06) and are read at the gate poll's block when it runs — but the watch is deliberately NOT gated by gate_signal.enabled, so rolling back the gate signal cannot silently stop watching the Root Reborn curation switch. Discrete values do not flap, so transitions need no hysteresis; a first observation seeds without emitting one, and a provenance-only change (assumed-default -> explicit at an unchanged value) is recorded but never paged. Netuid-keyed items (change: network-drift-452) additionally declare `hasher` and `netuid`; their pinned `key` is re-derived from the declared hasher on every pass and compared, after the same prefix self-test the mining reads use, so a wrong layout blocks the read instead of returning a null that looks like an unset default. `RootWeightsCap` is read at the root entry only: `subnets/weights.rs` consults `RootWeightsCap[ROOT]` and the map holds one entry (verified 2026-08-31, block 8963841).

items.governs: emission gate bar selection: N > 0 pins the bar to the Nth-largest demand share, N = 0 falls back to the q-mass quantile
q-mass bar threshold, applied only when the bar rank is 0
Hill gate sharpness: how hard emission collapses below the bar
Root Reborn basket curation master switch: while false every fund runs the null strategy and root dividends accumulate in place

root basket concentration cap: the largest u16-normalized share of a set_root_weights vector one destination may take; 4096/65535 = 1/16 forces a curated basket across at least 16 destinations (spec 449 default, DefaultRootWeightsCap)

wallet_aliases._comment: Operator public coldkeys only (no seeds/keys). Aliases resolve for live_portfolio account=.

CRUSTY.role: open non-Ledger wallet for agent management

subnets_taoswap._note: Post-processor surfaces emission_miner_burn (0-100 percent), root_proportion, moving_price, excess_tao_*, etc. client_params.netuid is a local filter only.

metagraph_taoswap._note: Keyless full-subnet metagraph. client_params.limit caps pruned neurons (default 25, max 64).

blocks_taoswap._note: Chain head without runtime spec_version — use chain_head_taostats when spec is needed.

chain_head_taostats._note: order pinned explicitly — the conviction enactment watch (spec_version >= 425)

subnet_identity_taostats._note: netuid -> on-chain SubnetIdentity.github_repo for the subnet-repo-fleet reconciler; paginated (aggregated to completion by run_subnet_identity); the endpoint does not provide the owner ss58
